scoring_justification: Checker independently recomputes diffusion distance X from the provided constants D=4.3e-17 cm^2/s and tau=200 h, converting to um, then compares agent's X_um within tolerance and verifies less_than_L.

outputs.description: Average Cr diffusion distance X at 400°C for 200h and its comparison to the interparticle spacing L=0.3 um. Contains fields: X_um (float, in um) and less_than_L (bool).

steps.description: Recompute Cr diffusion distance from the same input constants and validate agent's X_um and less_than_L.
